Package dev.px.core.setting

Class SettingChangeEvent

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.event.Event
dev.px.core.setting.SettingChangeEvent
public final class SettingChangeEvent extends Event
Posted after a Setting changes through Setting.set(T).

Lets unrelated systems react to configuration — the HUD rebuilding a cached layout, a module re-deriving a value it only computes on change — without every setting needing its own listener wiring.
